column1: The brewmaster handles the production of alcohol, which we all know to be the most important liquid in Dwarven Culture. They will inspect all barrel racks for the current state of fermentation.
column2: 酿酒总管负责酒类生产，而酒是矮人文化中最重要的液体。他们会查看所有酒桶架，判断当前的发酵进度。

column1:
Tired of the simplicity of brewing in DF? Want to wait months until your dwarves can drink anything you produce? Want to need to use fuel for brewing? Then this mod is for you!

Complicates the brewing process, everything now takes place in the new workshop: The Barrel Rack, it works automatically issuing a grab order for any fermentable it 
detects, which is produced in the still.

Also adds distillables, a highly valuable variant made with the use of fuel, and raises the value of all types of alcohol since it takes longer to produce
column2: 觉得矮人要塞的酿酒过程太简单？想让矮人等上数月才能喝到酿出的酒？想让酿酒也需要燃料？这个模组就是为你准备的！它让酿酒过程更复杂：蒸馏间先生产可发酵原料，再由新工坊“酒桶架”自动安排搬运并进行发酵。此外还新增了耗费燃料制作的高价值蒸馏酒，并因酒类生产耗时增加而提高了所有酒类的价值。

column1: Leave barrels here to ferment for months (Or years!) to create alcohol, it gets better with age!
column2: 把酒桶放在这里发酵数月（甚至数年！）以酿成酒，陈放越久，品质越佳！

Mod description: Tired of the simplicity of brewing in DF? Want to wait months until your dwarves can drink anything you produce? Want to need to use fuel for brewing? Then this mod is for you!

Complicates the brewing process, everything now takes place in the new workshop: The Barrel Rack, it works automatically issuing a grab order for any fermentable it 
detects, which is produced in the still.

Also adds distillables, a highly valuable variant made with the use of fuel, and raises the value of all types of alcohol since it takes longer to produce
column2:
觉得《矮人要塞》的酿酒太简单了？想等上几个月，才能让矮人喝到自己酿的酒？想让酿酒也消耗燃料？那这个模组就适合你！

这个模组让酿酒流程变得更复杂：现在所有发酵都在新工坊“酒桶架”进行。它会自动探测蒸馏房产出的可发酵原料，并下达搬运任务。

模组还加入了用燃料制成的高价值蒸馏酒；由于生产耗时更长，所有酒类的价值也都提高了。
